newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egypt to export electricity worth $7.6 billion through an Arab power grid from next year until 2017, minister says.
- Qatar's Rasgas project will produce 10 million tonnes of gas per year, official says.
- UAE banks are expected to achieve record profits in 1996.
- Yemen discusses financial reforms and setting up a bourse with the World Bank.
- UAE Central Bank warns against dealing with unauthorised financial companies.
- Bounced cheques in Jordan in the first 11 months of 1996 amounted to $566 million.
- Riyadh chamber of commerce offers 32 industrial, agricultural and services investment opportunities worth 1.4 billion riyals.
